directive: 目的、場所、人物、達成条件、報酬、時系列を正確に保って説明する。

entries.EN: Vovan admitted that he has the swag, but the location of the stash is on his PDA which he recently lost, and he doesn't remember it precisely himself. The PDA, he said, must be somewhere beyond the big hill to the east of the Valley, right by the barbed wire boundary fence.
entries.JA_current: Vovan admitted that he has the swag, but the location of the stash is on his PDA which he recently lost, and he doesn't remember it precisely himself. The PDA, he said, must be somewhere beyond the big hill to the east of the Valley, right by the barbed wire boundary fence.
entries.JA_new: ヴォヴァンはお宝を隠したことを認めたが、場所を記したPDAを最近なくしてしまい、正確な場所は覚えていないらしい。東の谷にある大きな丘を越えた先、境界の有刺鉄線のすぐそばにあるはずだ。

entries.EN: The mercenary Sly asked me to kill one of the diggers named Black Archaeologist. This digger wants to sell a batch of his weapons to Duty, and for some specific reasons, the merc customers are not too keen on this idea.
entries.JA_current: The mercenary Sly asked me to kill one of the diggers named Black Archaeologist. This digger wants to sell a batch of his weapons to Duty, and for some specific reasons, the merc customers are not too keen on this idea.
entries.JA_new: マーセナリーズのスライから、ブラック・アーキオロジストというディガーを殺すよう頼まれた。このディガーは武器をまとめてデューティーに売ろうとしているが、特別な事情があって、マーセナリーズの客はそれを快く思っていない。

entries.EN: You need to meet with the bandits named Caligula and Nero at the bandit base and ensure their safety during the fight with the stalkers-debtors.
entries.JA_current: You need to meet with the bandits named Caligula and Nero at the bandit base and ensure their safety during the fight with the stalkers-debtors.
entries.JA_new: カリギュラとネロというバンディットに、バンディット基地で会え。ストーカーの借金取りとの戦いの間、二人の身を守る必要がある。

entries.EN: A bandit named Mamai plans to kill the bandit leader Borov with our help. This should be done carefully. In the specified place, not far from the bandits' base, Mamai hid a sniper rifle, with which I must eliminate Borov. The leader of the bandits has a habit of approaching the window of his office during radio conversations, so it is advisable to take advantage of this fact to get a clear shot. The bandits may suspect that an attempt may be made on their boss so approaching the base is inadvisable. The photo that Mamai gave me shows the window where Borov will be located. One of Mamai's accomplices at the base will keep in touch with us through the PDA, giving us hints.

entries.JA_new: ママイというバンディットは、俺たちの手を借りてリーダーのボロフを殺すつもりだ。慎重に進めなければならない。指定された場所はバンディット基地から遠くない。ママイはそこでスナイパーライフルを隠してあり、それでボロフを始末する。ボロフは無線で話すとき、執務室の窓辺に寄る癖がある。そこを狙えば、確実に撃てるはずだ。バンディットはボスが狙われると疑っているかもしれない。基地には近づかないほうがいい。ママイが渡した写真には、ボロフが現れる窓が写っている。基地にいるママイの仲間の一人が、PDAで連絡を取り、手掛かりをくれる。
